title: [Dev-E] NSV3 is getting a queue and TBR aren't updated
symptom: TBR on AAPS seem to be unable to upload to NS thus making a queue. Carbs/boluses/notes/etc seem to be working fine. If I change to NSV1 all get uploaded and synced. Then problem starts again after switching to NSV3.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced in the thread. The commit hash is 0f89dfd159f235377dfc71b92acdc28fe9e8b3e8.
